purpose: Verify if normalization changes a username or matches an existing account (e.g. Kelvin sign K vs K).
expectedResult: Should be normalized to 'admin' before evaluation or treated as distinct, avoiding duplicate/shadow account registration.

purpose: Verify detection of homograph attacks where Cyrillic look-alike characters mimic Latin letters (e.g. 'а' in Cyrillic U+0430 vs 'a' U+0061).
expectedResult: Homograph defense should reject look-alike identities or treat them as completely distinct to prevent user impersonation.
